디도서 2:1.content: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

디도서 2:2.content: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

디도서 2:3.content: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

디도서 2:4.content: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

디도서 2:5.content: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

디도서 2:6.content: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

디도서 2:7.content: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

디도서 2:8.content: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

디도서 2:9.content: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

디도서 2:10.content: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

디도서 2:11.content: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

디도서 2:12.content: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

디도서 2:13.content: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

디도서 2:14.content: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

디도서 2:15.content: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
